scraped.scraped_description: Loomio is a collaborative decision-making app that saves time in meetings and keeps a record of decisions

name: Loomio
tagline: Make decisions together, without the endless meetings
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Small team size may limit maintenance capacity

policy_outcomes.description: Used in Zohran Mamdani's historic NYC mayoral primary campaign to coordinate 13,000 members with zero paid staff

outcome_methodology: Case study documentation of campaign coordination
published_performance_metrics: User engagement metrics available on platform; case studies published on Loomio blog
documented_limitations: Limited evidence on long-term decision quality outcomes
Scalability challenges for very large groups
jurisdictional_scope: International; primary deployments in New Zealand, United States, Europe, and Bulgaria
failure_modes: Low participation rates in some implementations
Decision fatigue in groups with frequent voting
curation_criteria: Open source contribution guidelines on GitHub; community moderation policies documented in platform terms
contributor_governance: Open source community contributions accepted via GitHub; core team maintains decision authority
community_ownership: Cooperative governance model explored; currently LLC structure with social enterprise mission

elections_used_in.election: NYC Democratic Socialists of America mayoral primary

political_relevance_summary: Loomio addresses enabling broader democratic participation and improving government service delivery and transparency. It has documented policy impact.

movement_building_utility.notes: Used by organizers and campaigners: Make decisions together, without the endless meetings.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase enables replication. already deployed internationally across multiple jurisdictions.
